sentence: This project studies how a receptor that is activated and cleaved helps prostate cancer become aggressive.
This project tries to find out how regulatory T cells protect skin stem cells from autoimmune attack.
This project builds a polymer-metal nano-complex that kills ovarian cancer cells, including drug-resistant ones, while sparing normal cells.
This project builds statistical methods that help medical researchers work with medical signals and images.
This project uses artificial intelligence to find small molecule drugs aimed at oncoproteins that drive a lymphoma.
This project builds a way to form 3D implants that fit each patient directly inside the heart to prevent stroke.
This project builds cancer models from patient tumors, using stomach and lung tumors, to test targeted treatments and study cancer health disparities.
This project studies how a protein that manages how the body responds to sugars affects liver health and metabolic disease.
This project studies how outpatient care for people living with HIV affects their risk of hospitalization and readmission.
This project supports the development of medical devices that diagnose and treat disorders of the nervous system.
This project provides support for collecting and analyzing flow cytometry and omics data in immunology research.
This project uses multimedia tools so children and families in hospital can use their own health data to learn about the body and diseases.
This project brings researchers together to speed the move of basic discoveries about nutrition and obesity into treatments for people.
This project uses epigenetic profiling, magnetic resonance imaging and machine learning to test whether controlled HIV infection speeds up biological aging and cognitive impairment.
This project studies how sleep and waking states affect network activity that leads to epileptic activity in patients with epilepsy.
This project builds protein drugs that act at the immunological synapse to control how immune cells send signals.
This project brings together basic, clinical and population research to reduce how often cancer occurs and how many people die from it.
This project studies how diabetes slows oral and skin wound healing and tests an inhibitor that blocks histone methylation.
This project provides equipment and expertise for studying metabolism, including mass spectrometry, genomics and cellular respiration.
